# quotes content

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:quotesContent`](gmeow-quotesContent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/quotesContent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)

Relates a work (a posting, an article) to content it quotes — another posting, a passage, an external resource. Non-functional: a work may quote several sources. Projects to [schema:Quotation](https://schema.org/Quotation) / [schema:citation.](https://schema.org/citation.) The quoted passage's text rides [`gmeow:quotedText`](gmeow-quotedText.md) when inline.
